nodes.label: NOXES Wordmark (text-only lockup)
nodes.content: Text-only NOXES brand lockup (SVG, viewBox 304x92) for headers/footers where the symbol is omitted. Renders 'NOXES' in off-white (#F4F1E9), font-family Barlow Condensed/Inter, font-size 82, font-weight 900, letter-spacing 4 at (0,72), plus a small vermilion (#E83708) rounded square accent (12x12, rx=2) at (268,58). Accessible via role=img and title 'NOXES'.
